facts.fact: The ITU repository lists the Botswana Digital Transformation Strategy (SmartBots) as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of the Botswana Digital Transformation Strategy (SmartBots) as 2021 - 2026.
The repository names the Ministry of Communications as lead/owner of the Botswana Digital Transformation Strategy (SmartBots).
